title: Mode Dock Tab Drag Preview
description: Remove inconsistent tab drag feedback (dashed insert slots, thick insert line, body highlight) when dragging Mode dock tabs; keep only a clean cursor-following tab preview.
summary: Simplified Mode dock tab drag feedback to a single cursor-following tab chip styled like a normal dock tab. Removed dashed insert slots in the tab bar, the accent insert line, and the body outline on tab-bar drops. Split/root-split drop zones still show the half-panel accent overlay. Tab-only drag preview uses modeDockInactiveTabClass and natural width instead of a fixed cap tile.
